title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theatre on 1970-02-02
lineage: SBD > MR > R > R > PCM > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a fiery show highlighted by an epic Dark Star and superb St. Stephen → Mason's Children transition
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the 20‑minute Dark Star, noting its soaring Garcia solo and tight Garcia/Lesh interplay, while the brief but brilliant St. Stephen and the rare Mason’s Children receive high praise for their seamless segue. The SBD source is praised as clear and resonant despite the recording being an abbreviated snippet of the full concert.

ai_rating.rationale: Over a dozen enthusiastic reviews (mostly 4–5 stars) praise both performance and soundboard quality; only minor complaints about the recording’s brevity keep it just shy of perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, resonant SBD with excellent clarity; occasional tape cut on Mason's Children but no noticeable distortion or drop‑outs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows powerfully, highlighted by a seamless transition from St. Stephen into Mason's Children and a marathon Dark Star that showcases inspired interplay.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s solo on Dark Star is described as “smoking” and “emphatically played,” with many noting his improvisational brilliance.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil Lesh’s bass work receives praise for tight interplay with Garcia, especially during the Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir gets credit for shining moments within the 20‑minute Dark Star.
